Startupový fond Czech Founders VC otevírá další kolo přihlášek.

Startup Maxifusion vyvíjí platformu pro automatizovanou tvorbu videoreklam a teď hlásí i získání investice 350 tisíc eur (8,4 milionu korun) od Czech Founders VC, andělského investora i samotných zakladatelů.
Kolo vedl fond Reflex Capital za účasti Czech Founders VC a Lighthouse Ventures.

analyst_notes: Ticket and stage from the investor's homepage focus block ('Pre-seed tickets. Typically €50-350k.'); CzechCrunch 2025-02-05 adds the Sherpa acceleration programme with an initial investment of about CZK 1m and follow-on up to about CZK 6m (the accelerator is part of the VC, so the accelerator flag is not set). Sector focus derived from cited portfolio companies (Maxfusion - AI video-ad platform, Merchantee - AI tools for marketplace sellers, Cruxo - retail-media SaaS); the site states no sector focus. Capital (fund size) not disclosed in the sources reviewed. Merchantee round amount is the CZK 30m seed extension (whole round). Maxfusion: CzechCrunch spells it 'Maxifusion' in the body and 'Maxfusion' in the headline. Distinct from United Founders, a new fund of Jakub Havrlant and Vít Horký (CzechCrunch 2025-11-04; CZK 430m committed, target in billions) - the Czech Founders VC homepage announces it ('We've launched United Founders!'); United Founders is not in this pilot list and was not researched further. Statutory body of the fund company: Vít Horký, Václav Pavlečka, Ivan Kristeľ.
